title: Satwik-Chirag Conquer China Masters, Eye Asiad Title Defence
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair secured a significant BWF Super 750 title, building momentum for their Asian Games title defense.
summary: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty won the China Masters, defeating Chinese rivals He and Ren 11-21, 21-13, 21-17 in a thrilling final, marking their second title of the year.

title: Satwik-Chirag Storm into Third China Masters Final
indian_angle: The Indian men's doubles duo advanced to their third China Masters final, setting the stage for their eventual title victory.
summary: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty defeated their Malaysian rivals in three games to reach the China Masters final, aiming for their second title of the year.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Announced for Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course signifies BAI's commitment to developing advanced coaching talent within India, crucial for nurturing future champions.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course to be held at the National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is vital for preparing India's promising young shuttlers for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: New regulations for the Inter State Team Championships will shape the format and competition for domestic badminton teams across India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for participating teams.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will be implemented in domestic ranking tournaments and national championships for U-13, U-15, and U-17 categories, impacting junior player development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
